annotations.title: Sorie to penance.
annotations.text: <mn>[1]</mn> The sorow which a man taketh for worldly losses or any temporal aduersitie, is not here commended, but that which is and ought to be in al men for their sinnes past, which is called here, Sorow towardes God and for penance, otherwise called Contrition, and is a thing excedingly requisite and much praised, the fruites whereof are these that the Apostle reckeneth, working saluation. Which doctrine is farre distant from <mn>[2]</mn> Luthers, and Caluins, and such wicked Libertines, that teach contrition to be al together a meanes to make sinners either hypocrites, or to put them in despaire.

notes.text: Contrition for a mans sinne worketh saluatió.
To.2. in assert. art. 6. a Leone damnat.
